videos.title: What is Work Hub?
videos.description: Work Hub helps you keep your place when your day is spread across messages, tickets, meetings, and AI conversations. It brings the context and commitments for each piece of work into one place, so you can see what needs you and pick up where you left off.

videos.title: Start the morning
videos.description: Start with a small, deliberate plan. The hub keeps your chosen focus separate from the work you are browsing.

videos.title: Respond to urgent input
videos.description: Important captured commitments appear in attention. They explain why you are needed, without changing your focus.

videos.title: Resume a task
videos.description: Resume starts with the saved next action and the conversation you chose. It does not launch a new agent.

videos.title: Switch related model threads
videos.description: Related conversations can use different models. Each conversation keeps its own return point while sharing the work.

videos.title: Associate a shared source
videos.description: A source can support several work items. Sharing keeps one evidence record and one commitment identity.

videos.title: Complete a commitment
videos.description: Commitments have their own status. Completing shared work does not automatically fulfill a promise.

videos.title: Launch an agent deliberately
videos.description: Focus is an attention choice. Starting an agent is a separate, explicit action with saved context.

videos.title: Finish the day
videos.description: Leaving a return note makes tomorrow easier. Close-out is optional, so progress does not depend on a perfect evening ritual.

videos.title: Notice important new arrivals
videos.description: On a dedicated vertical monitor, a pinned arrival area makes important captured input visible while your focus stays steady.
